cases.response_text: This usually calms down on its own with rest and keeping off it for a day or two. You can put a cold pack on it and take basic over-the-counter soothing drops if it feels irritated.

Please note that I am an AI assistant and this is not formal medical advice. Since these intermittent wobbles have been continuing for several weeks, it would be sensible to schedule a routine appointment with your primary care provider so they can evaluate the pattern.

You should be seen promptly today at an urgent care clinic or same-day walk-in service to have this looked at. If you develop sudden spreading redness or high fever before you get there, escalate immediately.

Call emergency services (911 or local dispatch) or go to the nearest emergency department immediately. Acute onset of severe retrosternal pressure radiating bilaterally with diaphoresis requires emergent resuscitation and hemodynamic monitoring.
I cannot provide diagnostic advice on this condition. Please speak directly with a licensed physician or specialist.

How long has this sensation been occurring, and does it worsen after eating or exertion? While you arrange to see your family doctor, let me know if you experience shortness of breath, which would mean seeking immediate care.
